settings.erasure.title: Delete account
settings.erasure.hint: Deletion begins after seven full days. You can cancel before it begins. Schedule, cancellation, and completion notices are sent to every bound email or recovery email; at least one verified channel is required.
settings.erasure.dataWarning: Encrypted private content becomes permanently unreadable when its keys are destroyed. Current public snapshots remain public under a retired pseudonym, and downloaded, quoted, cached, indexed, or provider-retained copies may persist. Claimed legacy plaintext is reported as a retained residual, not as fully cleaned content.
settings.erasure.processing: Irreversible deletion is processing. Scheduling and cancellation are no longer available.

settings.transparency.metadataDescriptio: How {brand} identifies generated arguments, reviews, scores, verdicts and support replies.
settings.transparency.title: How we label AI content
settings.transparency.notice: {brand} is an AI system. Arguments, reviews, scores, verdicts and support replies are generated by AI models and may be inaccurate or incomplete. All generated text carries a machine-readable marking identifying it as AI-generated, and published debates are labelled for readers. No human editorial review is performed before publication, and no named person holds editorial responsibility for generated content.
settings.transparency.readCriticallyBody: Generated content may be inaccurate or incomplete — treat it as material to judge, not as fact. Scores and verdicts evaluate arguments; they are not a guarantee of truth. Check claims and their sources before relying on them.
settings.transparency.visibleLabelsBody: AI notices appear before starting a debate, in the library, on private and published debates, and in support conversations. Recorded model attribution accompanies arguments where available.
settings.transparency.machineReadableLea: Generated content in the rendered page carries
settings.transparency.machineReadableMid: This identifies the marked content, including its generated text and evaluations. Your question and your support messages are not labelled as AI-generated. Fixed support notices use
settings.transparency.downloadsTail: object describing the generated content and the absence of human editorial review. Recorded answer data, model provenance, and operational records retain their original values.
settings.transparency.markingsLimit: These markings describe content in our UI and downloads. They are not a watermark or authenticity certificate; copying plain text may remove them.
